description: Aggregate total back wages, employees affected, civil penalties, and case count for an employer-name and/or state query. Computed client-side over up to 1000 largest matching cases by default, or page through up to 10000 with all_pages=true. Includes by_year totals, exact source employer identities, progress and explicit partial-data coverage. Optional inclusive date bounds and NAICS industry prefix. At least one of employer or state is required.

all_pages.description: Page through matches in case-id order, up to max_cases (maximum 10000). Reports progress and supports cancellation. Default false retains the largest-case sample.

employer.description: Employer name or fragment to search for. Matching is case-sensitive on DOL's side: the term is tried as typed, uppercased and title-cased, so a name stored with internal capitals ("ABC Plumbing", "JBS USA") needs that exact capitalization. If nothing matches, retry in the stored spelling or with a shorter distinctive fragment before concluding there are no cases.

found_after.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

found_before.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

max_cases.description: Max cases to aggregate over (default 1000; up to 10000 with all_pages=true).

naics.description: Industry NAICS prefix (1-6 digits), e.g. 72 for accommodation and food services.

name: back_wages_summary

description: Full record for one WHD enforcement case by its case id, including the per-statute breakdown (which labor laws were violated: FLSA, MSPA, H-1B, FMLA, Davis-Bacon, child labor, etc.).

case_id.description: The WHD case id (from employer_violations / violations_by_state results).

name: case_detail

description: Search WHD enforcement cases by employer name (matches trade name or legal name), optionally filtered to a state. Returns each case with location, findings dates, back wages, civil penalties, and employees affected. Ordered by back wages (largest first).

employer.description: Employer name or fragment to search for (e.g. "tyson", "golden gate restaurant"). Matching is case-sensitive on DOL's side: the term is tried as typed, uppercased and title-cased, so a name stored with internal capitals ("ABC Plumbing", "JBS USA") needs that exact capitalization. If nothing matches, retry in the stored spelling or with a shorter distinctive fragment before concluding there are no cases.

found_after.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

found_before.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

state.description: Optional 2-letter state code to filter by (e.g. "NY").

name: employer_violations

description: WHD cases carrying the dataset's FLSA repeat/willful violator flag, optionally in a state. The flag values are WHD's own (per its data dictionary: R = repeat, W = willful, RW = both). R also returns RW cases and W also returns RW cases, so an employer flagged both appears in either search. Ordered by back wages.

flag.description: Which WHD flag to search: "R" (repeat, default) and "W" (willful) each also return the "RW" (both) cases; "RW" returns only cases flagged both. R, W and RW are the only accepted values.

name: flagged_employers

description: The largest WHD enforcement cases by back wages — nationally, in a state, and/or in a date window. No employer name needed: use it to see what wage enforcement looks like in an industry or region, or to find the biggest recent actions.

found_after.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

found_before.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

naics.description: Optional NAICS code prefix (e.g. "72" for accommodation and food services).

name: top_cases

description: Top WHD enforcement cases in a state (cases where a violation was found), ordered by back wages owed. Optionally filter to an industry by NAICS code prefix (e.g. "72" for accommodation and food services).

found_after.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

found_before.description: Only cases whose findings ended on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive: a case that ended on this exact date is included.

naics.description: Optional NAICS code prefix to filter industry (e.g. "72", "722511").

name: violations_by_state
